propositions: When a Jira workflow forbids a direct end-state transition (e.g. open→done when only open→in_progress→done is allowed), the direct transition attempt fails and the ticket drifts unresolved.

Recorded status hops stored as append-only STATUS events provide a grounded, event-sourced sequence of actual transitions taken that can be replayed to reach the target state via allowed intermediate hops.

Replay must match the issue's current Jira status name against the recorded hop sequence in Jira-name space without inverting the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map, anchoring on the last positional match to resume.

Replay calls transition_issue_by_name once per remaining hop in order, aborting on any RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError, then falling through to comment-fallback and drift.
The local_id parameter must be threaded through _update_one_scalar_update to enable recorded_status_hops lookup, and the exception handler must be widened to attempt replay before comment-fallback.
